messages.author: cb1f888f7abbebfd
messages.subject: Thoughts on reusable shiny modules
parts:
How do people share shiny modules for common use cases? (both universally re-usable ones or domain-specific)

I've not been following developments in the shiny community very closely, but I used shiny apps extensively in my last role and I had created a package of modules (mostly for myself) so that I can reuse common functionality especially in a data-science context.  I especially found the debug (develop-within-the-app) module helpful, although perhaps there are better ways to accomplish what I was trying now.

Link to the package repository: https://github.com/rajkar86/shinypipe
- Just curious. Would people find any of these modules helpful?
- More generally, is there value in encouraging sharing modules, and building upon them?
 
Thanks in advance!
Karthik

messages.author: 19448cc3c031c2e4
messages.subject: Re: Thoughts on reusable shiny modules
parts:
I don't know it there is a standard or common way to share modules, but I appreciate that yours are available on github. I think the debug module will be useful to me and that there is value in sharing and building on what others have developed.

Thanks for sharing.
